description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component, focused on request validation and decision evaluation logic within the ExecHostRequest evaluation context. It tests different security and decision scenarios to ensure correct handling of command requests.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test functions to validate the behavior of ExecHostRequestEvaluator components.

methods.name: `validate request rejects empty command`
methods.description: Tests that validation rejects an empty command in ExecHostRequest.

methods.name: `evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision`
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator requires a prompt when allowlist conditions are not satisfied, and no prior decision was made.

methods.name: `evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss`
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator allows a one-time allow decision when allowlist is not satisfied.

methods.name: `evaluate denies on explicit deny decision`
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator correctly denies execution when an explicit deny decision is provided.
